title: SATA host: OOB bring-up (COMRESET / COMINIT / COMWAKE, ALIGNp lock), link layer with frame handshakes, CRC-32 and resends, and a built-in DMA command sequencer (IDENTIFY, then WRITE / READ DMA EXT read-verify)

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: link loss, illegal primitive, receive frame error (CRC, overflow, abort, handshake timeout), transmit failure (resends exhausted, timeout), unexpected or malformed FIS, error status, read data mismatch, or a command response timeout

notes: tx_p / tx_n, rx_p / rx_n (1 line bit per PCLK, no 8b/10b) and refclk (interface compatibility only) pass through unchanged. The host brings the link up and runs its command sequence on its own after reset.
The registers report the host's error events; commands and data stay on the serial pins.
